    "description": "The Customer Orders API offers functionality for managing customer orders.\r\n\r\n# Integration\r\n\r\nSee [general docs](https://docs.egretail.cloud/) for more information how to integrate with EG Cloud solutions.\r\n\r\nImport and export documentation can be found in the drop-down menu in the top right of this page\r\n\r\n## Errors\r\n\r\n- **400** – malformed request, or a missing or invalid `Idempotency-Key` header.\r\n- **404** – the order or other resource in the route doesn't exist, where the endpoint lists it. Also returned by any order write that recalculates prices when the tenant's POS cart calculator fails; nothing is saved.\r\n- **409** – conflict with the current state (concurrent edit, picking already started) or an `Idempotency-Key` already used for a different request. Re-read and reconcile before writing again; a plain retry only helps after a concurrent edit.\r\n- **422** – the request is invalid or not allowed in the current state (e.g. editing a Cancelled or Done order). An unknown order is 422 unless the endpoint lists 404.\r\n- **Idempotency-Key** – only on endpoints that list this header: resending the same request with the same key replays the first successful response; use a new key only for a different operation. Other endpoints ignore the header, so a retry runs the operation again (e.g. creates a second draft).\r\n\r\n## Health check\r\n\r\n[Click](/hc) to see health check status.",
